Parses the organization response, enforces exact-one cardinality, and returns the selected Moid.
properties.script:
import json
import sys

status = "ok"
statusCode = 200
message = "Organization resolved"
resultJson = "{}"
ready = False
organizationMoid = ""
try:
    body = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
    rows = body.get("Results") if isinstance(body, dict) else None
    if not isinstance(rows, list):
        raise ValueError("Organization response does not contain a Results array.")
    expectedName = sys.argv[2].strip()
    if len(rows) != 1:
        status = "not-found" if len(rows) == 0 else "conflict"
        statusCode = 404 if len(rows) == 0 else 409
        message = "Organization lookup must return exactly one result; received %d." % len(rows)
        resultJson = json.dumps({"error": message, "resultCount": len(rows)}, separators=(",", ":"))
    elif rows[0].get("Name") != expectedName:
        status = "identity-mismatch"
        statusCode = 409
        message = "Organization response does not preserve the exact requested Name."
        resultJson = json.dumps({"error": message}, separators=(",", ":"))
    else:
        organizationMoid = str(rows[0].get("Moid") or "")
        if not organizationMoid:
            raise ValueError("The exact organization result has no Moid.")
        resultJson = json.dumps({"organization": rows[0]}, separators=(",", ":"))
    ready = True
except Exception as exc:
    status = "malformed"
    statusCode = 502
    message = str(exc)
    resultJson = json.dumps({"error": message}, separators=(",", ":"))
    ready = True

import json
import sys
name=sys.argv[1].replace("'","''");organizationMoid=sys.argv[2]
familyUrl="/api/v1/workload/WorkloadDefinitions?$filter=Name eq '%s' and Organization.Moid eq '%s'&$orderby=Version desc&$inlinecount=allpages&$top=1000"%(name,organizationMoid)
deploymentsUrl="/api/v1/workload/WorkloadDeployments?$filter=Organization.Moid eq '%s'&$select=Moid,Name,Status,Organization,WorkloadDefinitionReference&$inlinecount=allpages&$top=1000"%organizationMoid
status,statusCode,message,resultJson,ready="ok",200,"Impact routes built","{}",bool(organizationMoid)

properties.description: Requires Updated and Valid, checks internal paging completeness, counts preferred-following deployments by status, and enforces active-rollout confirmation.
properties.display_name: Verify target and summarize rollout impact
properties.script:
import json
import sys
status,statusCode,message,resultJson,ready="ok",200,"Preferred-version impact summarized","{}",False
impactResultJson="{}";targetAlreadyPreferred=sys.argv[6].lower()=="true"
try:
 target=json.loads(sys.argv[1]);deploymentsBody=json.loads(sys.argv[2]);family=json.loads(sys.argv[3]);name=sys.argv[4];organizationMoid=sys.argv[5];confirmed=sys.argv[7].lower()=="true"
 org=target.get("Organization") if isinstance(target,dict) else None;validation=target.get("ValidationInformation") if isinstance(target,dict) else None
 if not isinstance(target,dict) or target.get("Moid")!=sys.argv[8] or target.get("Name")!=name or int(target.get("Version",0))!=int(sys.argv[9]) or not isinstance(org,dict) or org.get("Moid")!=organizationMoid: status,statusCode,message="identity-mismatch",409,"Target item identity changed."
 elif not isinstance(validation,dict) or validation.get("EngineState")!="Updated" or validation.get("State")!="Valid": status,statusCode,message="invalid",422,"Target definition must be Updated and Valid."
 else:
  rows=deploymentsBody.get("Results") if isinstance(deploymentsBody,dict) else None;count=deploymentsBody.get("Count") if isinstance(deploymentsBody,dict) else None
  if not isinstance(rows,list) or isinstance(count,bool) or not isinstance(count,int) or count<0: raise ValueError("Deployment impact response must contain a non-negative integer Count and Results array.")
  if count>1000: status,statusCode,message="paging-required",422,"More than 1000 organization deployments require internal paging; this export fails closed before mutation."
  elif count!=len(rows): status,statusCode,message="incomplete-page",422,"Deployment impact Results are incomplete relative to Count; this export fails closed before mutation."
  elif any(not isinstance(row,dict) or not isinstance(row.get("Organization"),dict) or row["Organization"].get("Moid")!=organizationMoid for row in rows): status,statusCode,message="identity-mismatch",409,"Deployment impact response contains an identity outside the requested organization."
  else:
   affected=[]
   for row in rows:
    mapper=row.get("WorkloadDefinitionReference") if isinstance(row,dict) else None
    if isinstance(mapper,dict) and mapper.get("DefinitionName")==name and mapper.get("UsePreferredVersion") is True: affected.append(row)
   byStatus={}
   for row in affected: byStatus[row.get("Status","Unknown")]=byStatus.get(row.get("Status","Unknown"),0)+1
   active=sum(value for key,value in byStatus.items() if key!="Draft")
   if active and not confirmed: status,statusCode,message="confirmation-required",400,"Confirm Active Deployment Rollout must be true because %d non-Draft deployments follow the preferred version."%active
   preferred=[row for row in family if row.get("PreferredVersion") is True]
   impactResultJson=json.dumps({"target":target,"impact":{"followingPreferredCount":len(affected),"activeFollowingPreferredCount":active,"byStatus":byStatus},"currentPreferred":{"Moid":preferred[0].get("Moid"),"Version":preferred[0].get("Version")} if preferred else None},separators=(",",":"),ensure_ascii=False);resultJson=impactResultJson
 if status!="ok": resultJson=json.dumps({"error":message,"mutationSubmitted":False},separators=(",",":"))
 ready=True
except Exception as exc: status,statusCode,message,resultJson,ready="malformed",502,str(exc),json.dumps({"error":str(exc)},separators=(",",":")),True

properties.description: Ends this terminal path after all four standard outputs are populated.

Resolves one exact validated workload definition version, identifies the current preferred version, and internally summarizes deployments that follow the preferred version. An already-preferred target with no strategy change is an idempotent success. Every state-changing request otherwise fails closed with 422 before PATCH because service-side clearing of a previous PreferredVersion flag, rollback behavior, and active-deployment rollout effects remain explicit live-tenant gates. No deployment collection is returned. Canary writeability follows CiscoDevNet SDK commit 0e8dfdb798aac11684966f0edbbd5e5ea3106dff.
